description: couchbase-cli-server-add.md's SYNOPSIS and OPTIONS correctly document --server-add-username/--server-add-password. Its second EXAMPLE, however, uses --server-username/--server-password, flags that do not exist on this command at all (confirmed: grep of the whole page shows only one EXAMPLE using the correct --server-add-username/--server-add-password; the other uses the incorrect pair). Those wrong names are exactly couchbase-cli-server-readd.md's own flag names for the equivalent parameter - direct copy-paste-across-siblings, not a typo unique to this page.
